result_preview.title: Procurement Matching Agent
result_preview.shortDescription: Autonomously matches purchase requisitions to optimal vendors based on cost, quality, and delivery performance.
result_preview.description: This agent analyzes open purchase requisitions against vendor master data, historical performance metrics, and material specifications to automatically recommend and create purchase orders. It evaluates vendor pricing, lead times, quality ratings, and contract terms to optimize procurement decisions, reducing manual effort and ensuring compliance with preferred vendor agreements.

result_preview.title: Vendor Material Procurement Coordinator
result_preview.shortDescription: Automates vendor selection and material sourcing aligned with sales opportunities.
result_preview.description: This agent monitors incoming sales opportunities and automatically coordinates with vendors to secure critical materials for fulfillment. It processes vendor availability data, negotiates lead times, and orchestrates material allocation across competing sales demands to optimize procurement efficiency and customer delivery timelines.

result_preview.title: Material and Vendor Master Data API
result_preview.shortDescription: Retrieves and manages material specifications and vendor master records for procurement operations.
result_preview.description: This API exposes comprehensive material and vendor master data, enabling systems to retrieve standardized product information, vendor attributes, and procurement-relevant classifications. It provides access to material hierarchies, vendor certifications, compliance statuses, and sourcing preferences to support goods receipt workflows and inbound logistics processing.
